notes: Single-stage: wire the public scalar-product API into the package root module per a written contract (int/float result typing, ValueError on length mismatch including one-shot iterators, TypeError on non-numeric elements, __module__ == 'dotkit'), then confirm the package still installs offline and exposes the same API installed. Hidden cases probe empty/single/mismatch/tuple/generator/large-int/precision inputs in both import modes; the root-module-definition requirement (no submodule re-export) is the packaging-structure core of the competency.
